designation: F124-C scientific causal-composition experiment; distinct from F124 autonomy PR #435
negative_finding: F123 Arm B Wingless margin 1/48 vs fixed 47/48 and Yggdrasil 3/48 vs fixed 43/48, so preregistered +0.05 BOTH-lane threshold not met; diagnostic upper cost proxies are not equal-compute proof.
hypothesis: A genuinely learned node-centric latent state accumulator using bounded permutation-invariant compressed messages can preserve causal variable binding across novel many-to-one reconvergences without enumerating candidate paths, and outperform an equally budgeted F123 route-expansion learner on unseen graph families. Naive pooling may falsely splice tokens from different routes; report that failure rather than hide it.

mechanisms.A: Node-state associative transport: learn a shared 16-to-8 raw-bit embedding and bilinear compatibility/gating in every query hop; aggregate incoming edge-messages per graph node into one bounded normalized latent state, then propagate. No candidate-path enumeration, oracle preselected route, exact equality feature or source ID.
mechanisms.B: Slot-separated latent-state transport: identical bounded message passing, but maintain exactly two permutation-invariant latent value slots per node with learned competitive routing and state normalization; same raw inputs, fixed message budget and training epochs; must expose effective slot use, nonfinite/overflow and collapse.
mechanisms.baseline_F123_B: Use strictly unchanged frozen F123 Arm B weights from Ubuntu TRAIN receipt sha256 12da879272212b899c6b942004ff38dc21ffa6bb20e7a81eac21d691746b474d; no retrain, no new original F123 CONFIRM reads; report F123 path-expansion memory and operation counts.
mechanisms.CTRL_FIXED_SOFT: Frozen 12-of-16 raw-bit Hamming compatibility on public graph; no exact-match oracle features, count every comparison.
mechanisms.CTRL_QUERY_ROLE_ONLY: Role-based route reachability without token identity.
mechanisms.CTRL_QUERY_TOPOLOGY_ONLY: 20-feature trainable topology-only logistic classifier, same 100 epochs, frozen parameter count.
mechanisms.CTRL_EXACT_PUBLIC_SYMBOLIC: Independent public slot-consistency dynamic traversal as separate ceiling, never included in nonlearned control selection.
mechanisms.CTRL_LABEL_BLIND_ABLATION: Frozen whole-edge order permutations, source/dest swaps at preselected route roles, and query-role perturbations with no counterfactual indicator given to model.

inputs.graph: Full unordered multi-edge directed graph with 16-bit raw src/dst slot tokens, query start/target and sequence of role tokens. Node keys, role keys and token encodings are per-pair salted opaque strings/bits; no truth, source vector, changed edge index, path witness or equality flags.
inputs.new_structure: Two or three route-compatible branches reconverge at an internal graph node, with incompatible carried tokens and a single potentially valid continuation; distinct near-miss alias, near-collision and role-decoy strata. Include parallel public edges. Negative example swaps one raw source slot on a valid continuation and one off-path decoy slot preserving complete per-bit token multiset and public topology.
inputs.admission: Independent symbolic reachability/traversal must score exactly one positive witness and zero negative witnesses. Any ambiguous or accidental alternative truth quarantined pre-scoring.
inputs.anti_shortcut: Balance edge count, degree, role/query, token population, edge order, reconvergence location and intervention position. Test label predictability after masking slot tokens and conditional source metadata. Reject if shortcut-only control yields material predictive advantage.

cohorts.train_selection_only: Select one arm solely on paired TRAIN accuracy, tie-break A; save exact candidate weights and metric digests before any CONFIRM.
cohorts.reserved_confirmation: Do not construct or inspect reserved confirm seeds before independent prospective source and first-use qualification.

evaluation.primary: Exact-identity paired correctness on reserved, genuinely unseen 7–9 hop reconvergent graphs, separately for Wingless and Yggdrasil, compared with strongest eligible resource-matched nonlearned heuristic AND frozen F123 learned B; symbolic ceiling reported separately.
evaluation.development_success: At least +0.05 paired accuracy over strongest eligible same-input, same-resource nonlearned heuristic in BOTH lanes, no adverse reconvergence/alias/near-collision stratum and nonzero learned parameter updates; also report signed comparison to frozen F123 B. Negative parity and invalid results must be retained. This is not scientific acceptance.
evaluation.resource_protocol: Count per-example actual primitive bit comparisons, multiplies, additions, sigmoid evaluations, node-state storage entries, max live messages and peak memory proxies for ALL arms/controls using same unshortcircuited traversal accounting. Flag incomparable budget instead of claiming superiority. Include wall-time median over 3 executions only as secondary on same fixed runner; no inferred energy/cost.
evaluation.causal_protocol: Posthoc blinded intervention of every role-compatible junction on each TRAIN graph, leave-one-branch-out tests, null-route ablation, edge-order permutation. Count overlap of highest impact edges with actual paired change after scoring; no leakage to candidate model.
evaluation.gating: No holdout-driven retuning, no original scientific experiment or admission from synthetic CI alone. No optimizer promotion, accepted ref mutation, or change to any historic hypothesis.

qualification: Protocol Git blob and exact source IDs must be captured prior to first generator implementation; TRAIN-only generator adversarial/source-split tests, focused model tests once implemented, then one final exact-head cross-platform full regression.
